neoxider-freetier.description: Reduced-tool profile for routes that refuse tool-less sessions (OpenCode free tier gate): no shell, no writes, no edits, no interactive prompts, no subagents, no MCP execution. Read-only files, todo/goal state and web reads stay, so the session still looks agentic to the provider. Verified live 2026-10-16: this set passes the free-tier gate on opencode/space-bunny-free while {"*": false} is refused with FreeTierError.
